description: Frictionless Table Schema of Platform/01-store/forms/daemon-flags.tsv (ADR-0125 addenda (12), (13); OBSH.39.3). Every field is a raw string: no type coercion. Constraints only where the header of the form or the existing check states them; CEL, JSON, owner, typed, numeric and prose-agreement rules stay with the existing checks (raw map of the change 0125-forms-table-schema-p01).

fields.name: flag
fields.description: The prose name: -flag, --flag, $ENV or <arg>; the order and the agreement with the prose table stay with check_flags.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The closed vocabulary of the header.

fields.name: required
fields.description: CEL; checked by the existing CEL guard on the raw text, not by this schema.

fields.name: commands
fields.description: daemon or subcommands of admin_ops, comma-separated (header).

fields.name: bad
fields.description: CEL; checked by the existing CEL guard on the raw text, not by this schema. Empty: no refusal beyond type and required.
